tasks.title: Timed entry answers for the ticket page

steps.request: The Crowdgate SDK, the package crowdgate-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in CROWDGATE_API_KEY; the ticket page already books through it. When every place in the time slot is taken, our ticket page must get the status 409 (Conflict), with the body { error: 'This time slot is full.' }, so it can show a friendly message. Every other refusal stays a 400 as today.

On busy mornings the door system is overloaded and asks us to wait a number of seconds. Then our ticket page must get the status 503 with the header Retry-After set to that number of seconds (30 when it gives none), and the body { error: 'Please try again in a moment.' }.
Groups of more than 10 visitors must book by phone: such a ticket answers 400 with the body { error: 'Groups over 10 book by phone.' } and nothing is held.
